zh-CN: 专精变化之道，以不同形态解决潜行、控制、冲阵与高阶战斗问题。
en-US: Master the art of transformation, using specialized forms for stealth, control, initiation, and high-level combat.

zh-CN: 将变化之术练至细微处，在七十二变菜单中解锁蜘蛛变化。
en-US: Refine your transformations and unlock Spider form in the Seventy-Two Transformations menu.

zh-CN: 变化更加迅捷诡谲，在七十二变菜单中解锁黑豹变化。
en-US: Your transformations grow subtler and more dangerous, unlocking Panther form.

zh-CN: 万象由心，在七十二变菜单中解锁枭熊与双脊龙两种高阶变化。
en-US: Shape follows will: unlock Owlbear and Dilophosaurus as advanced transformations.

zh-CN: 化作巨蛛，利用蛛网、攀行与毒性控制地形。
en-US: Become a giant spider to control terrain with webs, mobility, and venom.

zh-CN: 化作黑豹潜行伏击，以隐匿与突袭撕开敌阵。
en-US: Become a panther for stealth, prowling, and ambush attacks.

zh-CN: 化作枭熊冲入敌阵，以巨力、震地与怒吼控制战场。
en-US: Become an owlbear to break enemy lines with mass, shock, and battlefield control.

zh-CN: 化作凶猛双脊龙，作为七十二变路线的高阶猎杀形态。
en-US: Become a ferocious dilophosaurus, the subclass's advanced hunting form.
